text_block_list.text: Summer camp with Mihono Bourbon begins. Our goal here is to improve her abilities.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She carefully measures the ambient temperature and humidity, fully prepared to combat heatstroke.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Rice Shower is also working hard at summer camp, doing her best to motivate herself for the upcoming Kikuka Sho.
